# opnsense_dhcrelay_relay (Resource)

DHCP relays: forward DHCP requests arriving on an interface to a destination (Services > DHCP Relay > Relays). An interface can have one relay per address family, and must not also run a DHCP server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dhcrelay_destination" "dc" {
  name    = "domain-controllers"
  servers = ["192.168.10.5"]
}

# Relay DHCP from the guest VLAN (opt2) to the domain controllers.
resource "opnsense_dhcrelay_relay" "guest" {
  interface   = "opt2"
  destination = opnsense_dhcrelay_destination.dc.id
  agent_info  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) UUID of the `opnsense_dhcrelay_destination` to forward to.
- `interface` (String) Interface to listen on, e.g. `lan` or `opt1`.

### Optional

- `agent_info` (Boolean) Add relay agent information (option 82) to forwarded requests. Defaults to `false`.
- `carp_depend_on` (String) Only run while this CARP VIP is master (VIP UUID or address as listed by OPNsense); empty always runs. Defaults to `""`.
- `circuit_id` (String) Option 82 circuit ID; empty uses the interface name. Needs `agent_info` (OPNsense 26.7+). Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the relay. Defaults to `true`.
- `remote_id` (String) Option 82 remote ID. Needs `agent_info` (OPNsense 26.7+). Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the relay.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_dhcrelay_relay.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
